'''Kaminoan''' was the language of the natives of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. Many [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]] spoke both [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] and their native tongue. The language had a written form.<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" />

[[Ryan Kaufman]] was an interpreter who translated into Basic "''[[The Tale of the Aiwha Pod]]''", a Kaminoan story of the [[Deity/Legends|god-beast]] [[Protas]] and his [[Death/Legends|demise]] due to an [[Aiwha/Legends|aiwha]] [[Pod (social group)|pod]], who fought for their survival.<ref name="TAP">{{StoryCite|story=The Tale of the Aiwha Pod (short story)|book=Star Wars: Republic Commando: Prima Official Game Guide}}</ref>

===Words===
*''iiaa'' - A [[sea-mouse]].
*''oii'' - door
*''pod'' - A squad comprising [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] who were decanted together.
*''sso'' - the
*''uded'' - to close (can also be used as a command, as in "'''Close''' that book.")
